items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: I played around here with them for about three years, Joe Dansberg, Gideon Honoré, myself, Eddie Garland.

ctx.x: In Kansas City. Yeah. I stayed there about a little over a year and I left there and went to Chicago. Yeah. And I played with the Robinson Syncopators in Chicago for about a year around there and I left and came to California. Who else was in this Syncopators? Oh, I don't know all those different guys. They're from Chicago. Oh, yeah. I know. I only played with them for about a month or so, then I gigged around quite a bit, you know. And then I left and came to California. Came to Los Angeles. Yeah.
